title: Vegetable Biryani
description: A fragrant Indian rice dish with vegetables and spices.
ingredients: ½ tsp salt, adjust to taste
instructions: Rinse rice until the water runs clear, soak for 15 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in a covered pot. Fry onion for 5 minutes, then stir in vegetables and biryani spices for 3 minutes.
Add drained rice, water and salt. Bring to a boil, cover and reduce heat to low.
Cook for 15 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Rest covered for 5 minutes, fluff and serve.

title: Classic Tomato Pasta
description: Pasta tossed in a delicious tomato sauce.
ingredients: ½ tsp salt, adjust to taste
instructions: Boil pasta in salted water for the time on the packet. Reserve half a cup of cooking water before draining.
Heat olive oil and gently cook garlic for 30 seconds. Add chopped tomatoes, salt and pepper.
Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes soften into a sauce.
Toss pasta with the sauce. Add a splash of reserved water if needed and serve hot.

title: Masala Dosa
description: Crispy dosa filled with spiced potato masala.
ingredients: ½ tsp salt, adjust to taste
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes. Boil for 12–15 minutes until tender, drain and mash roughly.
Heat 1 tbsp oil. Add mustard seeds and curry leaves, then onion. Cook for 4 minutes. Stir in turmeric, salt and potatoes.
Heat a nonstick pan on medium heat. Spread a ladle of prepared batter thinly and drizzle a little oil around the edge.
Cook until golden underneath, add potato filling and fold. Repeat with remaining batter; serve with chutney.

title: Margherita Pizza
description: A classic pizza with tomato, cheese and basil.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C, or the temperature recommended on your pizza base packet.
Place the base on a baking tray and spread tomato sauce, leaving a small edge.
Add mozzarella and drizzle with olive oil. Bake for 12–15 minutes or until the base is crisp and the cheese bubbles.
Top with basil, rest for 2 minutes, slice and serve. Follow the base packet if its baking instructions differ.

title: Chocolate Brownies
description: Rich and chocolatey brownies for dessert lovers.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and line a 20 cm square baking tin.
Gently melt chocolate and butter together. Let cool slightly, then stir in sugar and beat in the eggs.
Fold in flour just until combined and pour the batter into the lined tin.
Bake for 20–25 minutes, until a skewer has moist crumbs but no raw batter. Cool in the tin before slicing.

title: Fresh Greek Salad
description: A refreshing salad with vegetables, olives and feta.
instructions: Wash and chop the cucumber and tomatoes into bite-sized pieces.
Put vegetables and olives in a serving bowl.
Crumble feta over the top and drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Toss gently and serve immediately, or refrigerate until serving.

title: Chicken Curry
description: A comforting chicken curry with aromatic spices.
ingredients: ½ tsp salt, adjust to taste
instructions: Pat chicken dry and season with salt and half the spice mix. Wash hands and utensils after handling raw chicken.
Heat oil and cook onion for 5–7 minutes. Add ginger-garlic paste and stir for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and remaining spices. Cook for 5 minutes, add chicken and water, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until chicken reaches 74°C in the thickest piece. Serve hot with rice.

title: Mango Smoothie
description: A creamy mango smoothie for a refreshing treat.
instructions: Peel the mango, remove the stone and dice the flesh.
Add mango, milk and yogurt to a blender.
Add honey if desired and ice. Blend until smooth.
Pour into two glasses and serve immediately.
